name: Nob
line: Nob was a city of the priests near Jerusalem, where David found help while running from Saul and where Saul later had the priests killed.

moments.title: David Gets Bread and a Sword
moments.text: David came to Nob, to Ahimelech the priest, while fleeing from Saul. Ahimelech gave him the bread set apart for God, and later gave him the sword of Goliath.

moments.title: Saul Destroys Nob
moments.text: Saul had Doeg the Edomite strike down the priests, and Doeg also killed the people of Nob and its animals. Abiathar, a son of Ahimelech, escaped and fled to David.

moments.title: An Enemy Halts at Nob
moments.text: Isaiah says an enemy army will stop at Nob and shake a fist at Jerusalem. Then the LORD will cut down the mighty with terrifying power.
